title: Chelex DNA Extraction
author: Jordan Sims
materials: Return tubes with swabs back to the fridge

steps.title: Set heat block temperature
steps.instruction: Turn on the heat block and set it to 55 °C.

steps.title: Label microcentrifuge tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare one 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube per sample and write the SampleID directly on the tube lid with a fine‑point Sharpie.

steps.title: Prepare Chelex suspension
steps.instruction: Vortex the stock 10 % Chelex solution for 60 seconds to resuspend; keep vortexing every few samples because Chelex settles quickly.

steps.title: Add Chelex to tubes
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of the 10 % Chelex solution to each labeled tube; continue vortexing the Chelex stock as needed to keep it suspended.

steps.title: Combine sample with Chelex
steps.instruction: For each batch of 24 samples, vortex the swab‑containing tubes in DNA/RNA Shield on max speed for 5 minutes, then transfer 10 µL of DNA/RNA Shield from each sample tube into the corresponding Chelex‑containing tube. Repeat this vortex‑transfer cycle a total of five times (four additional repeats) until all 112 samples are processed. You may vortex the next batch while transferring the current batch.

substeps.instruction: Vortex 24 sample tubes with swab in DNA/RNA Shield on max speed for 5 minutes.
Transfer 10 µL DNA/RNA Shield into the tube that already contains 100 µL Chelex.
Repeat the vortex‑transfer cycle five times for all samples.

steps.title: Mix after each transfer
steps.instruction: Vortex the 24 Chelex tubes on max speed for 30 seconds, then tap each tube on the bench or briefly spin in a mini‑spinner to collect liquid at the bottom. Repeat this vortex‑tap cycle five times (four additional repeats) for all 112 samples.

substeps.instruction: Vortex 24 microcentrifuge tubes on max speed for 30 seconds.
Tap the tube on the bench or spin briefly in a mini‑spinner to bring liquid to the bottom.
Repeat the vortex‑tap cycle five times for all samples.

steps.title: Heat incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate all microcentrifuge tubes in the heat block at 55 °C for 60 minutes, then increase the temperature to 95 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare storage cryovials
steps.instruction: During the incubation, label 2 mL cryovials with the SampleID, the word “DNA”, and the date using a fine‑point Sharpie.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet Chelex
steps.instruction: After incubation, centrifuge the 24 tubes at 14,000 rpm for 3 minutes to pellet the Chelex resin.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer approximately 80 µL of the clear supernatant from each tube into a clean, labeled 2 mL cryovial; avoid transferring any Chelex pellet, as it inhibits downstream PCR. Repeat this transfer for all 112 samples (the final batch contains only 16 tubes).

substeps.instruction: Transfer ~80 µL supernatant to a clean, labeled 2 mL cryovial.
Do not transfer any of the pelleted Chelex.

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Store the cryovials containing DNA at –20 °C (or appropriate freezer) for long‑term storage. You may centrifuge the next batch while transferring the previous batch’s supernatant.
